inner_split_contract: canonical fold-ID grouped split; pooled production threshold holds each of F1,F2,F3,F4 out once and trains on the other three development folds
P1_contract: canonical 36-feature HGB pairwise difference, BENEFICIAL>NEUTRAL>HARMFUL, deterministic cross-class pairs, mirrored rows, uniform weight
P4_contract: canonical 36-feature HGB, BENEFICIAL vs NEUTRAL_OR_HARMFUL, no class weighting, no resampling
top_action_tie_break: fused_score descending, drop_rank descending, incoming_union_rank ascending, incoming_doc_id lexicographic ascending
threshold_contract: candidates = +Infinity plus all unique frozen top fused scores; APPLY when fused_score >= threshold; maximize(gain_sum, precision_delta, threshold)
